action.details: Reproduces Fluent's generic PopClip action. ActionClip sends the selected text through Fluent's FLNT/SPNL Apple event. Fluent keeps that selection as action context rather than placing it in the prompt field; enable Show text selection as attachment in Fluent's Smart Panel settings if you want the selection shown in the panel.
action.exampleInput: Draft a concise reply confirming Friday's meeting.
action.exampleOutput: Fluent opens its Smart Panel with the selection available to its actions.

integration.name: Fluent
integration.summary: AI writing, translation, and editing actions powered by Fluent.

action.name: Fluent
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text to Fluent on this Mac. Fluent then uses the local or cloud model configured in Fluent.
action.requirements: Fluent 1.7.1 or later must be installed. macOS may ask you to allow ActionClip to control Fluent.
action.summary: Open Fluent's Smart Panel with the selected text as context.
action.template:
tell application id "net.epicbits.FluentStandalone"
    «event FLNTSPNL» "{{selected_text}}"
end tell
